definition: A decoding strategy that restricts sampling to the k most probable next tokens at each step, discarding the rest of the distribution.
details: Top-k sampling balances diversity and quality by preventing the model from sampling extremely unlikely (and often nonsensical) tokens while still allowing some randomness.
story: Think of a jazz musician who has heard so many solos that a new one simply falls out of their fingers. Boil it down and it is this: A decoding strategy that restricts sampling to the k most probable next tokens at each step, discarding the rest of the distribution. Here is why it matters: Top-k sampling balances diversity and quality by preventing the model from sampling extremely unlikely (and often nonsensical) tokens while still allowing some randomness. Creation, here, is memory recombined at speed. That next-word, next-stroke magic is Top-k Sampling.
